submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole reads the token at the current position and fires on lexical content words - nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs, including the word-initial sub-token of such a word in non-English text - while staying near zero on function words, pronouns, punctuation, digits, whitespace and code operators (each under 0.5% of its scan tokens). The strength is graded by the word rather than binary: it is reliably above the 0.25*max activity line on specific content words of written prose (view, views, viewing, reading, gazing, experiencing, teaching, thought, tour, holiday, outbreak, literacy, uncertainty, 1.0-1.6) and below it on short high-frequency generic words (tree, money, car, book, hand, face, make, see, take, think); the immediately preceding token only scales the magnitude (up to ~3x, higher after a reporting verb such as 'said', lower after a preposition such as 'of'/'on') and never switches firing on or off.

rival_explanations: The pole is specifically a seeing/experiencing detector for the view-viewing-tour-read family, so non-perception content words such as outbreak, shared or literacy should be near zero rather than active.

The pole is a generic open-class-word detector that fires on any content word, so common nouns and light verbs such as tree, money, car, book, hand or make should also be active above the line in ordinary prose.

The pole tracks contextual surprisal rather than lexicality, so a rare but ordinary noun after a reporting verb should fire as strongly as viewing, and a well-predicted 'viewing' after 'during the' should not fire.

With the DC Cinematic Universe gaining more and more success with films like Wonder Woman and Aquaman, fans are curious to see what else is in store for the next few years. A teaser has been released of what is said to be Harley Quinn’s next big screen appearance with Birds of Prey. The Suicide Squad will not be featured in this as far as fans can tell, yet Harley still has a whole new cast of characters joining in this film.
The film will be introducing new characters from DC Comics fame, with Huntress (Mary Elizabeth Winstead), Black Canary (Jurnee Smollett-Bell), Cassandra Cain (Ella Jay Basco), and Renee Montoya (Rosie Perez). Alongside the female ensemble cast we get Victor Zsasz (Chris Messina) and Black Mask (Ewen McGregor) being featured as who will most likely be the main antagonists. All of the characters were showcased in the new teaser alongside Margot Robbie returning as Harley Quinn herself. The moments are brief with shots of each characters, but fans are still receiving a good look to how the characters will appear in this new film, even with a new outfit for Harley Quinn.
Birds of Prey (And the Fantabulous Emancipation of One Harley Quinn) is still in production as of now, but an official trailer for the film will probably be released sometime before the end of the summer.
The Suicide Squad follow up is set to be release on February 7, 2020.

Le championnat d'Espagne de rugby à XV de 2e division 2020-2021, qui porte le nom de División de Honor B 2020-2021 est une compétition de rugby à XV qui oppose trente-six clubs espagnols.

Format de la compétition 
Les clubs sont répartis en trois poules géographiques. Le groupe A correspond à la zone Nord : y jouent les équipes des Asturies, de Cantabrie, de Castille-et-Léon, de Galice, de Navarre, de La Rioja et du Pays basque. Le groupe B correspond à la zone Est : y jouent les équipes d'Aragon, des Baléares, de l'Est de Castille-La Manche, de Catalogne, de Murcie et de la Communauté valencienne. Le groupe C, appelé Centre-Sud, accueille les autres clubs de Castille-La Manche, mais aussi les clubs d'Andalousie, des Îles Canaries, d'Extrémadure et de Madrid. Le titre se dispute sous forme de phases finales, où le vainqueur est promu en División de Honor, tandis que le finaliste peut jouer un barrage contre l'avant dernier de División de Honor.

Du fait de la pandémie de Covid-19, le format de la compétition est modifié. 
 Lors du premier tour, chaque équipe se rencontrera une fois (6 équipes recevront 6 fois, 6 autres ne recevront que 5 fois).
 Les six meilleures équipes du premier tour se joueront entre elles dans une nouvelle phase de poule, les six autres tenteront d'éviter la relégation. Les résultats acquis lors du premier tour face aux concurrents de la poule de classement sont conservés.
 Le titre sera déterminé après une phase finale. Le vainqueur est promu, tandis que le vice-champion joue un barrage de promotion.
 En phase de relégation, le dernier est relégué, et l'avant dernier doit jouer un barrage. Néanmoins, cela est susceptible d'être modifié selon les promotions et relégations avec la première division, avec de conserver l'équilibre de 12 clubs par zone géographique.

Τα Σφηκαίικα είναι οικισμός της Ναυπακτίας στο νομό Αιτωλοακαρνανίας σε υψόμετρο 160 μέτρα. Σύμφωνα με το σχέδιο Καλλικράτης, μαζί με τη Γέφυρα Μπανιά και  Βλαχομάνδρα αποτελούν την Τοπική κοινότητα Βλαχομάνδρας που ανήκει στη Δημοτική Ενότητα Ναυπάκτου του Δήμου Ναυπακτίας και σύμφωνα με την απογραφή 2011 έχει πληθυσμό 28 κάτοικους. Το χωριό βρίσκεται ΒΔ. της Ναυπάκτου, σε απόσταση 19,5 χλμ. από αυτήν, πολύ κοντά στις νότιες όχθες του Εύηνου ποταμού και απέχει από τη Γέφυρα Μπανιά 2,5 χλμ.. Πολύ κοντά στον οικισμό βρίσκονται τα «Λουτρά Βλαχομάνδρας».
Ως οικισμός αναγνωρίστηκε για πρώτη φορά το 1940 και προσαρτήθηκε στην τότε κοινότητα Βλαχομάνδρας, ενώ σύμφωνα με το σχέδιο Καποδίστριας, το 1997, μαζί με τη Γέφυρα Μπανιά και τη Βλαχομάνδρα ανήκε στον τότε Δήμο Ναυπάκτου.

adversarial_test_results.detail: English function words only (pronouns, copulas, negation, conjunction) with no open-class word, so the hypothesis predicts near-zero on every token.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Would it have been? It could have been. It might have been; it must have been.

Punctuation and symbols only; the hypothesis reports punctuation under 0.5% of its scan tokens.
Punctuation scattered across line breaks, testing the punctuation class at the delimiter positions where activation spikes often sit.

Dates, times and measurements made only of digits and punctuation; the checker called the earlier percent sign a noun, so it is removed and the remaining tags are NUM, PUNCT and SYM.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Ordinary prose whose only content words are the short high-frequency generics the hypothesis places below the 0.25*max line (car, tree, book, hand, face, make, take), so the hypothesis predicts inactive while a generic open-class rival predicts active.

A whitespace-heavy indented line whose only real tokens are two English function words (the, is) and a brace/semicolon pair, so whitespace, punctuation and function words - all classes the hypothesis calls inactive - carry every measured turn.

readings.explanation: The pole reads the token at the current position and fires on lexical content words - nouns, verbs, adjectives and adverbs, including the word-initial sub-token of such a word in non-English text - while staying near zero on function words, pronouns, punctuation, digits, whitespace and code operators (each under 0.5% of its scan tokens). The strength is graded by the word rather than binary: it is reliably above the 0.25*max activity line on specific content words of written prose (view, views, viewing, reading, gazing, experiencing, teaching, thought, tour, holiday, outbreak, literacy, uncertainty, 1.0-1.6) and below it on short high-frequency generic words (tree, money, car, book, hand, face, make, see, take, think); the immediately preceding token only scales the magnitude (up to ~3x, higher after a reporting verb such as 'said', lower after a preposition such as 'of'/'on') and never switches firing on or off.

The pole is specifically a seeing/experiencing detector for the view-viewing-tour-read family, so non-perception content words such as outbreak, shared or literacy should be near zero rather than active.

The pole is a generic open-class-word detector that fires on any content word, so common nouns and light verbs such as tree, money, car, book, hand or make should also be active above the line in ordinary prose.

The pole tracks contextual surprisal rather than lexicality, so a rare but ordinary noun after a reporting verb should fire as strongly as viewing, and a well-predicted 'viewing' after 'during the' should not fire.
